privacyPage.description: What information we collect when you use this site or contact us, why we collect it, and the choices you have.
privacyPage.seoDescription: DevRox Privacy Policy: what data we collect through thedevrox.com, how we use it, your privacy rights under GDPR and other laws, and how to contact us.
privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy

privacySections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: DevRox Technologies ("DevRox", "we", "us" or "our") operates the website thedevrox.com (the "Site"). This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect when you visit the Site or contact us, why we collect it, how we protect it, and the choices you have.
We aim to collect as little as possible and to be transparent about how it is used. If you do not agree with this policy, please do not use the Site.

privacySections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: Information you provide directly. When you submit our contact, consultation or book-a-call forms, we collect the details you choose to share — such as your name, business email address, company name, phone number, project type, budget range and message. If you email us directly, we receive the contents of your message.

Information collected automatically. Like most websites, our hosting provider and analytics tools may automatically record limited technical data when you visit the Site, such as your IP address, browser type, device information, referring page and the pages you visit. We use this only to keep the Site secure, to fix errors and to understand aggregate usage.

privacySections.heading: How we use your information
paragraphs: We use the information we collect to respond to your enquiry, to prepare for and follow up on consultations, to operate and improve the Site, and to protect the Site against misuse. We do not use your information for unrelated marketing without your consent.

Where the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) applies, our legal bases for processing are: your consent (for example, when you submit a form), our legitimate interests in running and securing our business, and steps taken at your request before entering into a contract.

privacySections.heading: Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: The Site may use cookies or similar technologies for basic functionality and to understand aggregate usage through privacy-respecting analytics. You can control cookies through your browser settings; blocking some cookies may affect how the Site works.

privacySections.heading: How we share your information
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We share it only where necessary: with service providers who help us operate the Site and communicate with you (such as hosting, analytics, email and scheduling providers), who are required to handle it confidentially and only for that purpose; and where required by law or to protect our rights, safety or property.

privacySections.heading: Data retention
paragraphs: We keep enquiry information for as long as needed to respond to you and, where relevant, for the duration of an engagement and a reasonable period afterwards for record-keeping. Technical logs are kept for a limited period for security purposes. You may ask us to delete your information at any time (see "Your rights" below).

privacySections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you, to restrict or object to certain processing, and to receive a portable copy of your data. If you are in the EU/EEA or the UK, you also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection supervisory authority.
To exercise any of these rights, email us at hello@thedevrox.com. We will respond within a reasonable timeframe.

privacySections.heading: Data security and international transfers
paragraphs: We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information, but no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure. We are based in Pakistan and serve clients worldwide, so your information may be processed in countries other than your own, where data protection laws may differ.

privacySections.heading: Children's privacy
paragraphs: The Site is intended for a business audience and is not directed at children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 16.

privacySections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The current version will always be posted on this page with its effective date. Material changes will be highlighted here.

privacySections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: DevRox Technologies. If you have any questions about this policy or how your information is handled, email us at hello@thedevrox.com.

We may update these terms from time to time; continued use of the Site after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

Any engagement for paid services is governed by a separate proposal, statement of work or written agreement. In case of conflict between that agreement and these terms, the agreement prevails for the engagement.

termsSections.heading: Acceptable use

termsSections.heading: Intellectual property

You may view and print pages for personal, non-commercial use, but you may not reproduce, distribute or create derivative works from our content without our prior written permission.
Intellectual property created for clients under a paid engagement is governed by the applicable proposal or agreement.

termsSections.heading: Third-party links and tools
paragraphs: The Site may link to third-party websites, tools or services (for example, scheduling or analytics providers). We are not responsible for their content, policies or practices, and you access them at your own risk.

termsSections.heading: No warranties
paragraphs: The Site and its content are provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including warranties of accuracy, completeness, merchantability or fitness for a particular purpose. We do not guarantee that the Site will be uninterrupted or error-free.

termsSections.heading: Limitation of liability

termsSections.heading: Changes to these terms

termsSections.heading: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of Pakistan, without regard to conflict-of-law principles. Any dispute arising from the Site shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Lahore, Pakistan.

paragraphs: DevRox Technologies. For questions about these terms, email us at hello@thedevrox.com.
